correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed truncated-tetrahedron edges from ordered pairs (i,j), yielding 12 vertices/18 edges; tested all 4095 nonempty masks with induced degree at most one: 863 faces, f=(12,66,192,303,228,62). The declared vertex order yields 428 Morse pairs and critical dimensions 0:1,3:3,4:3, with all 3,432 Hasse covers acyclic. Exact signed gradient 3-by-3 d4 vanishes; pi3 of the 3-skeleton wedge^3 S3 equals Z^3, so all three four-cell attaching maps are nullhomotopic and the wedge^3 S3 plus wedge^3 S4 follows integrally. This supports correctness even though an earlier stronger result covers it.
residual_risks: Self-contained exact finite reconstruction does not itself certify the historic original tree identity; locked Git blobs and source tree SHA guard supplied.
